notes: ἀφ᾽ ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων is split three ways: rule 94 forbids a compound prepositional unit where the ASV spreads the phrase over separate words, so the noncompositional reading named in that unit's note is in fact ruled out by rule 94.
Ἄνδρες is unrepresented and ἀδελφοί takes the single word Brethren; no part of that word answers to Ἄνδρες, so rule 39's compression arm does not join them.
The supplied that before by my mouth goes to the infinitive under rule 85, ἐπίστασθε already having its own that.
